purpose: Teach: アトム/ウィルソン/ロジャー/琢磨/綾子/ユーゴ/金具/悪しき

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、鉄腕アトム好きだったよな
lines.en: Riku, you used to be obsessed with Astro Boy, didn't you.
lines.style: Teasing opener with a smirk; drawn-out ending on the tag, daring him to deny it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会でウィルソン大統領調べてたな、桜
lines.en: And you were the one researching President Wilson for social studies, right, Sakura.
lines.style: Cool deflection, volleying it straight back; flat delivery with a flicker of real interest.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、テニス部でロジャー・フェデラーのフォーム真似してたな
lines.en: Riku, I saw you copying Roger Federer's form at tennis club.
lines.style: Mock-impressed rise on the famous name; grin audible, needling him about the imitation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、F1のニュースで佐藤琢磨応援してたろ、桜
lines.en: You were cheering for Takuma Sato on the F1 news, weren't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Casual mumble sharpening into the counter; faint smile cracking through his guarded tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、隣のクラスの綾子と話してたな
lines.en: Riku, you were talking to Ayako from the class next door, weren't you.
lines.style: Sly, insinuating slowdown on the girl's name; the raised eyebrow practically audible.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会で旧ユーゴ紛争習ったろ、桜
lines.en: You learned about the old Yugoslav conflict in social studies, right, Sakura.
lines.style: Quick, offhand return fire; slightly hurried, eager to move the spotlight off himself.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、家具の金具直すの上手だったな
lines.en: Riku, you were actually really good at fixing the metal fittings on furniture.
lines.style: Genuine praise slipping past the sarcasm; softer tone, almost reluctant admiration.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、文化祭で「悪しきを断ち善きを為す」って書道してたな、桜
lines.en: And you did that calligraphy at the culture festival — "cut off evil, do good" — didn't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Quieter, sincere close; slowing over the calligraphy phrase like it actually stuck with him.
